OPEN_L3_1_resolution.OPEN_L3_1A_Go: CLOSED — Go advisory in SAFE state CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED. Evidence: EV-02 (Rahim et al. 2024 Fishing season behavioural regime), EV-03 (Gao 2024 tripartite go/cautious-go/don't-go), EV-04 (Yamin et al. 2025 SAFE-equivalent operations). Internal design lineage: EV-08 (dataset-label-derivation.md SAFE->Go label — not independent evidence). Inference bridge required: YES — broader favourable-conditions behaviour -> canonical all-SAFE operationalisation -> Go advisory candidate. Geographic adaptation to Kota Kinabalu required. One candidate rule: R-SAFE-001.
OPEN_L3_1_resolution.OPEN_L3_1B_Delay: CLOSED — Delay advisory candidates in CAUTION state are CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED. R-CAUTION-001 has the strongest environmental-premise authority (P_ENV Level A — MET Malaysia Category 1), but the Delay mapping remains inferred (P_ADV Level C). R-CAUTION-002 through R-CAUTION-004 are Level C (wave/rain/wind). Evidence: EV-01 (MET Malaysia Category 1 Level A), EV-05 (Jeong & Im 2023 departure restrictions by wave height), EV-06 (Yaakob et al. 2015 Malaysian vessel seakeeping operability), EV-02 (Rahim et al. 2024 East season restricted operations), EV-07 (Atacan & Düzbastılar 2023 risk perception). Internal design lineage: EV-08 (dataset-label-derivation.md CAUTION->Delay label — not independent evidence). Four candidate rules: R-CAUTION-001 through R-CAUTION-004.
OPEN_L3_1_resolution.OPEN_L3_1C_DepartureTime: OPEN — No scientific authority in the repository. dataset-label-derivation.md Section 6.3 explicitly defers DepartureTime labeling to RQ5 fieldwork. Tide-gating evidence (Gao 2024) suggests departure time is port-specific and tide-dependent but no advisory-level specification was found. Tide (t) is not in E vector. Requires: domain expert elicitation from Kota Kinabalu Zone A fishers and/or tidal almanac data.
OPEN_L3_1_resolution.OPEN_L3_1D_Duration: OPEN — No scientific authority in the repository. dataset-label-derivation.md Section 6.3 explicitly defers Duration labeling to RQ5 fieldwork. Rahim et al. (2024) duration evidence is from UNSAFE-equivalent conditions when Layer 3 does not operate. Requires: domain expert elicitation or DoF Malaysia operational guidelines.
